title: Launch in India with India-Sweden Innovations' Accelerator (ISIA)
summary: Energimyndigheten invites Swedish companies to apply for the India-Sweden Innovations' Accelerator (ISIA) program, tailored to help companies introduce their solutions to the Indian market. The current date and availability of the offer must be confirmed as stated in the text.
audience: Swedish small and medium-sized enterprises with innovative solutions in the energy and sustainability sector
eligibility_note: This is a potential match, eligibility is unconfirmed. Requirements include being a Swedish SME with high energy relevance, a prioritized strategy for the Indian market, necessary personnel and financial resources for internationalization, proven technology with intellectual property rights, and the ability to submit a certificate of de minimis aid.
next_step: Submit an expression of interest via the Energimyndigheten website no later than November 15.

title: Driving Urban Transitions: Sustainable Urban Transformation within European Partnership
summary: Apply for funding from the European partnership Driving Urban Transitions (DUT) to establish transition labs that promote sustainable urban development and support transnational research and innovation projects.
audience: Forskningsutförare, offentliga organisationer, företag (ej enskild firma) och civilsamhällesorganisationer
eligibility_note: This is a potential match, eligibility is unconfirmed. Project teams must consist of at least three partners from three different countries participating in the partnership, and sole proprietorships (enskild firma) are not eligible.
next_step: Review the call details on the source website and prepare the step 1 application before the deadline.

title: Efficient Energy Use in Buildings for a Sustainable Energy System
summary: This funding opportunity provides support for research and innovation projects developing new solutions, technology, perspectives, and knowledge, as well as innovation clusters to strengthen development through collaboration for efficient energy use in buildings.
audience: Companies, industry organizations, municipalities, public organizations, universities, research institutes
eligibility_note: This is a potential match, and eligibility is unconfirmed. Stated requirements include targeting efficient energy and power use in buildings, and projects involving diverse actors such as industry, academia, and research institutes are viewed particularly positively.
next_step: Review the full call text on the Energimyndigheten website and submit an application via their system by the deadline.

title: Swedish-German Cleantech Platform 2027
summary: A support programme for Swedish small and medium-sized cleantech companies aiming to establish themselves on the German market. The program provides individual coaching, market expertise, tailored business meetings, and participation in delegation trips and international events. This is a potential match, eligibility is unconfirmed, and applicants must offer an innovative product for fossil-free energy systems, prioritize German market expansion during 2027, possess necessary resources, and meet EU SME definitions.
audience: Swedish small and medium-sized cleantech enterprises (SMEs)
eligibility_note: This is a potential match, eligibility is unconfirmed, and requirements include being a Swedish SME, offering an innovative product or solution for fossil-free energy systems, prioritizing expansion to the German market during 2027, owning the developed technology, and having sufficient personnel and financial resources.
next_step: Submit an application via the Swedish Energy Agency website by 1 December 2026.

title: FORESTPathways International Call for the Forestry Sector
summary: This is a potential match, eligibility is unconfirmed. The FOREST partnership under Horizon Europe invites international research and innovation projects contributing to a sustainable and resilient forestry sector. Swedish participants can apply for funding through Energimyndigheten, Formas, and Vinnova for projects focusing on timber, innovative wood-based products, value chains, markets, and governance (Themes 3 and 4).
audience: Research organizations, public organizations, companies (excluding sole proprietorships), and civil society organizations forming international consortia.
eligibility_note: This is a potential match, eligibility is unconfirmed. Applicants must form an international consortium with at least three partners from three different participating countries. Swedish funders only finance projects within Theme 3 and Theme 4.
next_step: Review the call details on the FOREST partnership website and prepare the step 1 application before the deadline.

title: Concept Development of Business-Focused Innovations
summary: Financing is available to develop innovations aimed at a sustainable energy system, bringing solutions closer to the market by focusing on commercialization potential, energy relevance, and prototyping.
audience: Registered small and medium-sized enterprises (legal entities), universities, and higher education institutions.
eligibility_note: This is a potential match, eligibility is unconfirmed. Requirements include that the solution must be at TRL 2 to TRL 4 at project start, applicants must hold disposition or ownership rights to the solution, and private individuals and sole proprietorships cannot apply.
next_step: Review the full call text and checklist, prepare the mandatory 'Additional application questions' document, and submit your application via the official channels before the deadline.

title: Verification of Innovations with Customers
summary: Funding for small and medium-sized enterprises to develop and verify innovative solutions together with a potential customer, aiming to bring energy innovations closer to commercialisation and contribute to a sustainable energy system.
eligibility_note: This is a potential match, and eligibility is unconfirmed. Requirements include that the solution must be at a Technology Readiness Level (TRL) between 4 and 7 at project start, the applicant must hold ownership or disposition rights to the solution, co-financing is required, and a dated and signed letter of intent from at least one participating customer must be attached.
next_step: Read the full call text, review the checklist, prepare the mandatory documents including a letter of intent from a customer, and submit the application via the official channels before the deadline.

title: Apply for support for capital raising
summary: An accelerator program for growth companies planning an investment round of more than 30 million SEK in the coming year, offering advisory services, matching with international investors, and event participation.

eligibility_note: This is a potential match, eligibility is unconfirmed. Requirements include being an unlisted SME in Sweden planning an investment round exceeding 30 million SEK, high energy relevance, strong growth potential, and basic investor materials ready.
next_step: Review the full call text and submit an application by the deadline.
